findings.reason: The original standalone tile shows a complete readable procedure but no diagram. Two separate streams with different attention access materially benefit from a computation-flow picture: target causal self-attention is distinct from source keys/values supplied to every decoder layer. The expanded editorial diagram criterion warrants adding this illustration despite the complete step list.
findings.action: Added a final Remarks section with a two-stream TikZ dataflow diagram and explicit abstraction/shape explanations.

correction: Appended an explanatory encoder-decoder flow diagram distinguishing source representations E, causal target processing, cross-attention keys/values, final decoder states D, and rowwise next-token probabilities P. Entire original item remains byte-identical as a prefix; metadata/status/dependencies/source references and procedure are unchanged.

diagram_math_checks.objects_and_shapes: Source stream has n tokens and X,E in R^(n x d). Target stream has m prefix tokens and U,D in R^(m x d). P is m x |V| for the existing finite vocabulary; each row is a probability vector.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Original procedure steps 1–3 and 5, Outputs, and supplier def-transformer-encoder-decoder-layer row-token conventions. The existing output linear map has one vocabulary logit per coordinate; softmax preserves row count.

diagram_math_checks.relations: Source tokens -> embedding + position -> X -> encoder stack -> E; target prefix -> embedding + position -> U -> decoder stack -> D -> rowwise output map/softmax -> P. All nine directed edges on ten boxes represent dataflow, not inverse maps or mathematical commutative-square assertions.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Procedure steps 1–5 in their stated order; E and D boxes also explicitly represent returned intermediate matrices.

diagram_math_checks.attention_access: Within each decoder layer, self-attention permits j <= i; cross-attention obtains keys/values from source E and queries from current decoder rows. The E-to-decoder arrow is directed into the decoder and is labeled keys/values, source rows.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Procedure step 4 and Outputs; supplier definition specifies masked self-attention then cross-attention then positionwise feedforward, including residual/LN operations. Adjacent prose explicitly preserves additional allowed masks and the complete residual/normalization conventions. The figure makes no claim that source attention must assign positive weight to every source row.

diagram_math_checks.independence: The original algorithm definition and all five procedure steps are unchanged; the figure is explanatory and supplies no logical premise. No proof was supplied by this algorithm item, and the diagram does not replace or assert one.
